Card Q&A.a: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to digivolve it into a Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name in my hand/trash regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Effect: [When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name in the hand or trash.
Inherited Effect: [End of Attack] By deleting this Digimon, you may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
